# Fairpointe

> Fairpointe helps UK organisations evaluate and deploy specialist enterprise technology, and helps international technology companies enter, sell and deliver in the UK.

Contact: hello@fairpointe.co.uk

## Pages

- [Home](https://fairpointe.co.uk/): Enterprise technology, deployed in the UK. Fairpointe helps organisations deploy AI, cloud, data and security technology into production. Technologies we deploy and integrate: OpenAI (ChatGPT Enterprise, API integration, agents), Microsoft Azure (Azure AI Foundry, enterprise AI infrastructure), Microsoft Copilot (Copilot Studio agents, integrations, governance), AWS (Amazon Bedrock, AI cloud infrastructure), Snowflake (Snowflake Cortex, enterprise data), Databricks (Mosaic AI, enterprise GenAI), Anthropic (Claude Enterprise, Claude API, agents), ElevenLabs (voice AI agents, speech and audio integration). These describe implementation capability, not partnerships. Capabilities: enterprise AI and agents, cloud and data platforms, security and identity, systems integration. Lifecycle: evaluate, integrate, deploy, operate. For international technology companies: local commercial and technical capacity to win and deliver UK opportunities.
- [AI & Security](https://fairpointe.co.uk/ai-security): Evaluate and deploy emerging AI and security technology. Approach: evaluate, integrate, deploy, operate. Includes AI agent and non-human identity security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra, GitHub, Kubernetes, SaaS applications and MCP infrastructure.
- [Cloud & Infrastructure](https://fairpointe.co.uk/cloud-infrastructure): The cloud foundation required to deploy and operate enterprise technology across AWS, Microsoft Azure and hybrid environments: cloud architecture, platform engineering, cloud security, infrastructure automation, migration and modernisation.
- [UK Market Entry](https://fairpointe.co.uk/uk-market-entry): A UK commercial and technical partner for international enterprise technology companies. Commercial and technical capability in six phases: market development, technical pre-sales, proof of concept, deployment and integration, customer engineering, ongoing support.
- [Public Sector](https://fairpointe.co.uk/public-sector): Specialist technology for the UK public sector, from procurement opportunity through technical evaluation, integration and deployment. Covers cloud and infrastructure, AI and automation, security, data and software implementation.
- [About](https://fairpointe.co.uk/about): Built by operators. A UK enterprise technology company combining commercial execution with hands-on technical delivery. Leadership: Adebola Adeniran, Founder and Technology Lead.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fairpointe.co.uk/privacy): How Fairpointe UK Limited handles personal information.
- [Contact](https://fairpointe.co.uk/contact): Enquiries about technology projects, UK market entry, public sector, AI and security, or cloud and infrastructure.
